name: Icon
convert: Cut out by hand once from C2-shield-icon-v1.png (1024 x 1024, flat grey background): the background keyed out by saturation (HSL, 20%) merged with a 14% flood fill from the edges, the floor and its reflection masked off below the shield's tip, the largest shape kept, the edge eroded 1 px and softened 0.5 px, trimmed to 679 x 876 and centred on a clear 960 x 960 canvas (8-bit RGBA). Steps kept in the project files with the picture.
prompt: Stylised cartoon game icon, a heraldic shield seen straight from the front, perfectly symmetrical, bold clean shapes, thick dark outline, flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, thick bronze-gold rim with four large amber gems, deep navy panel, a very large chunky polished brass serif letter V filling most of the panel, bright and high contrast, hand-painted game art style, plain flat mid-grey background, no floor, no shadow, no other text
negative: photograph, realistic, 3D render, floor, reflection, perspective, swords, weapons, scratches, fine detail, small text
